role: Commissioner of Agriculture, Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
stance_basis: form submitted with no adverse comments checked, no enclosures attached
summary: Doyle Conner, Commissioner of Agriculture for the Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services, submitted a standard clearinghouse review form indicating no adverse comments on the draft environmental impact statement pertaining to ORV use on public lands. His agency is listed among those 'endorsing the proposal or offering no adverse comments.' The form shows no enclosures attached and no specific concerns raised.
complaint_summary: Commissioner Conner submitted a standard clearinghouse review form for the ORV draft environmental impact statement, checking no items for comment and indicating no enclosures, effectively offering no adverse comments on the proposal.
